name: BlueSkies Highlighted Products for WooCommerce
author: BlueSkies Digital

sections.description:
BlueSkies Highlighted Products for WooCommerce lets store owners choose default highlighted products and optionally override them per post. Output is rendered via the [bshp_highlighted_products] shortcode, so it can be placed in widget areas or anywhere else where shortcodes are processed.

Features:

  • Display highlighted products card links wherever you want.
  • Increase your chances of converting SEO traffic to sales.
  • Choose default WooCommerce products on the settings screen.
  • Per-post overrides of global settings via the BlueSkies Highlighted Products metabox on public post types.
  • Shortcode supports hardcoded IDs: [bshp_highlighted_products ids="12,34,56"].
  • Skips hidden or invalid products automatically.

External services

This plugin can optionally connect to BlueSkies Digital (https://blueskiesdigital.com) when a site administrator opts in to receive plugin updates and related news.

What the service is used for

To let administrators subscribe for plugin update notices, compatibility tips, and occasional offers related to this plugin.

What data is sent and when

Only after the administrator checks the consent box and submits their email on the plugin settings screen, onboarding overlay, or reminder dialog, the plugin sends:

  • The administrator’s email address (as entered or prefilled from their WordPress user account)
  • The site URL (home address of this WordPress installation)
  • A plugin source identifier and version string (for compatibility notices)

Data is sent via HTTPS POST to the plugin developer’s server. No store visitor or customer data is sent.

Legal information

This service is provided by BlueSkies Digital:

  • Terms of Service: https://blueskiesdigital.com/wordpress/highlighted-products/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://blueskiesdigital.com/wordpress/highlighted-products/privacy-policy

Privacy Policy

This plugin may offer site administrators an optional way to receive plugin updates and related news from the plugin developer. Participation is never required to use the plugin.

What we collect (only with your explicit consent)

If you check the consent box and submit your email, the plugin may send your email address, site URL, and plugin version to BlueSkies Digital as described in the External services section above.

When collection can happen

  • A one-time welcome overlay the first time you open WooCommerce → Highlighted Products Widget (you may continue without email)
  • An optional “Stay in the loop” step on the settings page when saving configuration
  • An occasional reminder dialog if you save settings again after at least seven days without having opted in previously (you may dismiss it without subscribing)

What we do not collect

  • Store visitor or customer emails, orders, or browsing behavior
  • Analytics or tracking pixels on the front end of your site

Storage on your site

If you opt in, your consent choice and email may be stored in the WordPress options table on your site. You can remove this by uninstalling the plugin.

For more information, see https://blueskiesdigital.com/wordpress/highlighted-products/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the zip via Plugins → Upload Plugin → Select the zip → Install Now.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Highlighted Products Widget, configure products, and save.
  4. Add [bshp_highlighted_products] to a widget area or page content.
sections.faq:
Does this collect visitor or customer emails?

No. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit data from your store visitors or customers.

What data is sent, and when?

Only if a site administrator explicitly opts in (by checking the consent box and submitting their email) may the plugin send that administrator’s email address, site URL, and plugin version to BlueSkies Digital via a secure HTTPS request. Opt-in may be offered on a first-visit welcome screen, on the plugin settings page (optional “Stay in the loop” step), or in an occasional reminder after saving settings if you have not opted in before. Nothing is sent without the plugin user’s explicit consent. The plugin does not send any emails from your WordPress site.

Can I use the plugin without opting in?

Yes. You can skip email collection and use all plugin features regardless, including product selection, the shortcode, and per-post overrides.

What if a product becomes private?

Products that are not visible in your WooCommerce catalog are skipped automatically when the shortcode renders.
